account.label: Sending domain
account.help: The domain in your Mailgun account that messages are sent from, as Mailgun names it (e.g. mg.example.com).

credentials.name: MAILGUN_API_KEY
credentials.label: API key
credentials.help: A Mailgun API key that may send for the domain.

endpoint.label: Endpoint (EU region or self-hosted only)
endpoint.help: Leave empty for Mailgun's US API (https://api.mailgun.net). For the EU region use https://api.eu.mailgun.net.

config.name: from
config.label: From address
config.help: The address messages are sent from, with an optional name, on the sending domain.

config.name: reply_to
config.label: Reply-To address
config.help: Where a family's reply goes. Unset, replies go to the From address.
